exports.name: Static model gallery
exports.detail: 92 model files covering 87 source IDs plus 5 variants are published in the model gallery.
exports.limits: This current gallery snapshot differs from the historical conversion catalog; do not add the counts together. It does not establish complete animation or runtime behavior.

exports.name: A01 animation package
exports.detail: A01’s 102-take animation package is published. Actual Blender import was checked with a 30,000 FPS global import clock that preserves clip duration in seconds.
exports.limits: Compatibility-qualified export, not standard-engine or original-game equivalence. Runtime billboard behavior is documented in a companion, not delivered as an executable engine integration.

exports.name: A02 animation package
exports.detail: A02's 102-slot body-animation package is published with three embedded/external atlases, sanitized validation and four diagnostic previews. Actual Blender checks passed 102,330 queries at a 30,000 FPS global import clock preserving seconds.
exports.limits: Qualified body export, not full native rendering. Source-hidden helpers are omitted; runtime visibility, node3 auxiliary effects, dynamic materials and original shaders/pass behavior remain unqualified. Unreal/other-engine equivalence is not certified.

exports.name: A05 animation package
exports.status: Published · qualified full Blender body bank
exports.detail: A05's full 102-slot package replaces its one-take standard coverage. Actual Blender checks passed 113,135 queries with maximum position error 0.00459733369384 under the fixed 0.005 gate. The 30,000-FPS global import clock preserves seconds.
exports.limits: Source-effective first weights are retained, not substituted gallery weights. Default-hidden helpers/runtime visibility, native shaders and engine equivalence remain unqualified. Historical slot001 ZIP remains available but excluded from standard totals.

exports.name: Animation conversion queue
exports.detail: The public animation catalog contains 13 model IDs and 408 standard take records across full and partial banks. A03 and A04 are held pending decisions; A06 is active; A07 is next, not yet started.
exports.limits: Catalog records are not a complete game animation total. Optional A21 and historical A05 first-clip overlaps are excluded from standard totals. Held candidates are not published as qualified full banks.

exports.name: Identification progress
exports.detail: 31 stage-information resources are linked to retained labels across 73 supported record pairs. 217 weapon resource codes have retained UI labels, covering 209 distinct labels.
exports.limits: These are evidence-backed label associations, not verified canonical retail names or runtime identities. Resource and record counts are not unique maps or weapons.

exports.name: Backup progress
exports.status: 322 model records backed up · transfer work pending
exports.detail: Backup coverage includes 322 model records: 108 characters, 122 stages and 92 Zoids. Another 309 recovered models remain transfer-pending.
exports.limits: Model records include variants and are not unique entities. Recovery and structural verification do not mean transfer is complete, and these counts are not additional public downloads.

systems.name: HSD geometry & skinning
systems.detail: 627 historical model exports are currently available and hash-verified, including 539 non-Zoid outputs. All passed bounded container and embedding checks; detailed records are in the asset inventory.
systems.limits: Per-model results do not prove every format variant, visual detail, map assembly or original-game behavior.

systems.name: Textures
systems.detail: The 539 verified non-Zoid outputs contain 12,832 texture records referencing 1,322 embedded images, with no external resource URIs.
systems.limits: Coverage is bounded to inspected outputs; image presence alone does not prove every UV, color-space or rendering detail.

systems.name: Materials & render states
systems.detail: Material and rendering-state behavior is partially identified. Current structural inspection found 16,327 material records across 539 non-Zoid outputs.
systems.limits: Record presence does not establish material equivalence or original rendering correctness. Some rendering behavior needs runtime integration.

systems.name: Rigs & skeletal animation
systems.detail: Rig and animation work has per-model qualification, including A01’s actual Blender import of the published 102-take package.
systems.limits: This is bounded export evidence, not universal rig compatibility or native-game equivalence. All 627 historical GLBs checked in the refreshed inventory are static, with zero animation clips; separately published animation packages are independent.

systems.name: Animation curves & source timing
systems.detail: Scalar curve compilation and source-clock reconstruction are validated on admitted profiles, including marker extensions. A01’s Blender-qualified export uses a 30,000 FPS global import clock that preserves duration in seconds.
systems.limits: Validation does not cover every source curve profile or every engine playback path. Other banks require their own conversion and checks.

systems.name: IK, direction, pole & limit constraints
systems.detail: Constraint operators have been reconstructed and qualified for specific models and supported profiles.
systems.limits: This is not a claim that all game constraints are decoded or that ordinary interchange-format playback reproduces every native constraint.

systems.name: Expressions & procedural operators
systems.detail: Expression operators have reconstruction and model-specific qualification evidence.
systems.limits: Qualified models and operators do not establish complete game-wide expression coverage or full native-runtime equivalence.

systems.name: Billboards & view-dependent behavior
systems.detail: A01’s published package documents a runtime billboard companion. It provides data and integration guidance rather than an executable engine integration.
systems.limits: View-dependent behavior is not automatically reproduced by standard animation import. Runtime implementation and verification remain necessary.
